body:
From ADR-004 (docs/wiki/decisions/adr-004-roles-and-adoption.md), priority 1 — manual mode is dishonest until this lands.

Bug: hkb claim without --spawn writes manual: true (src/cli.js:419) but nothing reads it. The reclaim chain (src/dispatch.js:438) marks any same-host, no-pid attempt crashed after 180s regardless of heartbeat — so any tick, even --max 0, kills a live hand-claimed attempt after 3 minutes: lock released, card re-readied, the agent's next heartbeat dies with LOCK_LOST.

Fix (~3 lines + test): honor manual like remote in the reclaim chain — liveness by heartbeat / stale_after / max_runtime only, never the 180s no-pid rule. Add a fake-gh test: hand-claimed attempt with a fresh heartbeat survives ticks; one past stale_after is reclaimed. Document in the skill: heartbeat or be reclaimed after stale_after (default 1h).
title: Reclaim must not kill live hand-claimed attempts: honor 'manual' like 'remote'
